card.name: Digits of a size before a length unit
card.fires_on: Digits inside a length or size figure, such as 3-8 ft, 1/16 inch or 60 cm, where a unit comes next. It fires on the number, before the unit is written.

modes.label: Animal or plant size
modes.description: Digits of a body length or plant height before feet, inches or centimeters.

modes.label: Equipment or dosing size
modes.description: Digits of a plug size, cream thickness or container height before a length unit.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing mm and away from inch after the number.
card.plain: It marks a length number that is about to be followed by a unit, favoring millimeters over inches.
